name: Raptor Mastery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Let's see how you handle this next challenge.  There is a cagey breed of raptor out there.  We call them Jungle Stalkers.  They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at.  Kill 10 Jungle Stalkers and I'll tip you off to the best hunting yet.
narrative.objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Jungle Stalkers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer! Nicely done, old chap!
narrative.requestItemsText: Bah! What are you doing standing around, adventurer! A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. Silly bloke.
